findings.reason: naming the existing predicate owner (or extracting one helper in `parallel.py`) lets §14 express its root scope through it, which removes the duplication the plan would otherwise deepen and is a one-file change of the same size as the fragment it replaces.
findings.text: §14 proposes `AND any(p IN $root_prefixes WHERE n.path = p OR n.path STARTS WITH p + '/')` as new text in the paths reset, but the paths-claim layer already spells "under these roots" five times inline (`AND any(root IN $root_filter WHERE p.path STARTS WITH root)` at parallel.py:483, :539, :596, :714, :794), and `seed_facility_roots`/`claim_paths_for_expanding` already accept a `root_filter`; the plan neither names this recurring duplicate nor extracts one owner for it, so the subsystem gains a sixth spelling in a second module

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the live design adds no module and no fan-out of small wrappers; it makes two field-level changes inside one already-deep owner (`imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py`) and one call-site change in the paths command, each with a test.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 introduces a sixth root-scoping predicate (as the `reset_to_status` `extra_filter` fragment) beside the five inline copies already in `imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py` (:483, :539, :596, :714, :794), none of which the plan names or consolidates.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 adds no option to any family (it scopes the existing `--reset-to` with the existing `--root`), so there is no new surface to retire or merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 names and extends the existing owner rather than adding a reprocess subsystem: `reset_to_status` with `extra_filter`/`extra_params` and `PATH_RESET_SPECS` in `imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py`, citing the signals command's precedent at `imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py:224`; verified `reset_to_status` already takes both parameters (reset.py:53) and that `expanded_at` is never cleared anywhere in the package.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — nothing is wrapped; §14 modifies the owner in place (add `expanded_at` to the `scanned`/`triaged` `clear_fields`, pass `--root` prefixes through `extra_filter`) rather than layering a parallel path over it.
